verdictSummary: All four owner findings are accepted: each held case is a concrete false merge or misattribution, and the owner identified the right separations. The owner operations cannot be applied literally. The extraction split leaves p111 name and sex claims citing s0220 after its mention moves, invents the name surface 大司農鄭眾, misuses mentionException and links p137 to p111. The p035 hint and westernBounds fail the native validator. The detach-member operations are not native resolution decisions, and when written as plain splits they produce wrong clusters in three of four cases. The supportedPatch below corrects all of these; it validates natively and yields exactly the intended clusters. No concrete source contradiction remains once the supportedPatch is applied. The four sealed plan rows stay hold until the host applies the patch, reconciles the scoped date rows and reseals; then only the five predicted rows need recording.

primaryWitnessUnits.quote: 周章字次叔，南陽隨人也。
primaryWitnessUnits.zh: 周章字次叔，南陽隨人也。
primaryWitnessUnits.enLiteral: Zhou Zhang, courtesy name Cishu, was a man of Sui in Nanyang.
primaryWitnessUnits.enIdiomatic: Zhou Zhang, styled Cishu, came from Sui in Nanyang commandery.

primaryWitnessUnits.enLiteral: That winter he replaced Yin Qin as Minister of Works.
primaryWitnessUnits.enIdiomatic: That winter he succeeded Yin Qin as Minister of Works.

primaryWitnessUnits.quote: 章以眾心不附，遂密謀閉宮門
primaryWitnessUnits.zh: 章以眾心不附，遂密謀閉宮門，誅車騎將軍鄧騭兄弟及鄭眾、蔡倫，劫尚書，廢太后於南宮，封帝為遠國王，而立平原王勝。
primaryWitnessUnits.enLiteral: Zhang, because popular hearts did not attach, then secretly plotted to shut the palace gates, execute Chariots-and-Cavalry General Deng Zhi and his brothers along with Zheng Zhong and Cai Lun, seize the Masters of Writing, depose the empress dowager in the Southern Palace, enfeoff the emperor as king of a distant state, and enthrone King of Pingyuan Sheng.
primaryWitnessUnits.enIdiomatic: Zhou Zhang, finding popular hearts unattached, secretly plotted to shut the palace gates, execute Deng Zhi and his brothers along with Zheng Zhong and Cai Lun, seize the Masters of Writing, depose the empress dowager in the Southern Palace, banish the emperor to a distant kingdom, and enthrone Prince Sheng of Pingyuan.

primaryWitnessUnits.enLiteral: The plot was discovered; he was dismissed by edict; Zhang killed himself.
primaryWitnessUnits.enIdiomatic: The plot was discovered; he was dismissed by edict and killed himself.

primaryWitnessUnits.zh: 論曰：吳起與田文論功，文不及者三，朱買臣難公孫弘十策，弘不得其一，終之田文相魏，公孫宰漢，誠知宰相自有體也。
primaryWitnessUnits.enLiteral: The appraisal says: Wu Qi debated merit with Tian Wen; Wen did not reach him in three respects; Zhu Maichen challenged Gongsun Hong with ten strategies; Hong did not obtain one of them—in the end Tian Wen ministered Wei, Gongsun ruled Han; truly they knew the prime minister has his own substance.

Chancellorship is a different art altogether.

Houhanshu 38 s0098 吳起與田文論功…田文相魏 retells Shiji 65 s0116-s0130 魏置相，相田文 and Wu Qi's merit debate with him.

Liangshu 14 s0262 類田文之愛客 alludes to Lord Mengchang 孟嘗君 of Qi, the patron of retainers, active about 300-279 BC; Wu Qi's rival chancellor of Wei served before Wu Qi died in 381 BC. The prior model merges (cohort-2026-08-27-01 #67, prompt-v7-batch-2026-08-13-continuation-50j #5501) conflated the two Tian Wen.
